market_outlook.short_term: Risk-on bias from US-China talks and EM rally, but capped by oil inflation and front-end yield volatility. Expect choppy, range-bound equities with sector rotation into energy and AI infrastructure. Midterm election narrative amplifies consumer and gas-price sensitivity. Buffett's departure creates a brief sentiment vacuum in value-investing circles.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains the dominant structural theme but is transitioning from infrastructure build-out to revenue validation — winners will separate from laggards. US-China normalization, if sustained, supports global growth and EM outperformance. Energy transition constrained by refinery bottlenecks and longer oil routes. US debt trajectory (CBO forecast breach) is the slow-burn systemic risk. Housing affordability remains structurally impaired.
